name: Animation timeline manages frames, toggles onion skinning, and runs playback
description: Verify adding animation frames, toggling onion skinning, and starting animation playback.

planSteps.description: Verify the bottom timeline displays Frame #1 in the frame reel
Click the Frame button (title 'Add Blank Frame') in the timeline controls
Verify Frame #2 appears in the frame thumbnail reel
Click the Onion Skin button in the timeline controls
Verify the Onion Skin button activates with gold background styling
Click the PLAY button to start animation playback
Verify the playback button text changes to PAUSE during playback
